title: Cross-validation, leave-one-out, and Rademacher complexity
brief: Build k-fold cross-validation, the one-fit leave-one-out shortcut, a learning curve, and a random-sign estimate of how flexible a set of models is.
hints: k_fold_indices needs three calls: rng.permutation(n), np.array_split(order, k), and np.sort on each piece.
In cross_val_score, create rng = np.random.default_rng(0) inside the function, so two calls on the same data use the same folds. np.setdiff1d gives the training indices for each fold.
For loo_linear_smoother, build H = X @ np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X + lam * np.eye(d)) @ X.T. Take r = y - H @ y and leverage = np.diag(H), then average (r / (1 - leverage)) ** 2.

learning_curve shuffles once with np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n). The first round(val_fraction * n) indices are the validation set, and pool[:size] is each training set, so the training sets nest.

empirical_rademacher: signs = rng.choice(np.array([-1.0, 1.0]), size=(num_draws, n)). Then losses_matrix @ signs.T has shape (num_hypotheses, num_draws). Take .max(axis=0), then the mean, then divide by n.
